Donor CUDA algorithm headers are copied verbatim from ggml/src/ggml-cuda.
ggml public/runtime-facing headers are reduced compatibility stubs for the AOT leaf.
Original donor header copyright/license notices are retained.

`quantize.cu` contains the verbatim MMQ Q8_1 template and dispatcher range extracted from the pinned commit's `ggml/src/ggml-cuda/quantize.cu`, wrapped in `llama_donor` to avoid symbols colliding with the SGLang AOT quantizer. Original surrounding copyright/license header retained below.
